# MIT Libraries LibGuides

> A comprehensive research guide platform providing discipline-specific resources, databases, and support for MIT students, faculty, and researchers across engineering, sciences, humanities, and professional fields.

MIT Libraries LibGuides serves as the primary discovery and instructional portal for the MIT community, offering curated subject guides, database access, research tools, and liaison librarian support across all academic departments and research areas. The platform integrates with major research databases and citation management tools to support the full research lifecycle.

## Key Topics

- Research Guides
- Academic Databases
- Citation Management (Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote)
- Web of Science
- Liaison Services
- Archival Research
- Engineering Resources
- Scientific Databases
- Compendex
- Art History Resources
- Reference Services
- Research Tools
- Library Resources

## Resource Discovery & Core Services

- [A-Z Databases](https://libguides.mit.edu/az.php): MIT Libraries A-Z database directory for comprehensive resource discovery and access
- [Class & Program Guides](http://libguides.mit.edu/classguides): MIT Libraries class and program guides hub providing course-specific research support and instructional resources

## Engineering & Applied Sciences

- [Aeronautics and Astronautics](https://libguides.mit.edu/aero-astro): Aeronautics and Astronautics research guide with aerospace databases and specialized engineering resources
- [ASME Papers & Publications](https://libguides.mit.edu/asme-pubs): ASME papers and mechanical engineering publications research guide with access to engineering literature
- [Architectural Design](https://libguides.mit.edu/archdesign): Architectural Design research guide with design databases and specialized tools for architecture students

## Sciences & Natural History

- [Astronomy, Astrophysics, & Planetary Science](https://libguides.mit.edu/astro): Astronomy and astrophysics research guide with scientific databases and observational resources
- [Earth Sciences, Atmospheric Sciences, & Oceanography](https://libguides.mit.edu/earth): Earth sciences research guide covering atmospheric and ocean sciences with specialized datasets
- [Anthropology & Archaeology](https://libguides.mit.edu/anthro): Anthropology and archaeology research guide with academic databases and field research resources

## Arts, History & Cultural Studies

- [Architecture and Art: History, Theory, & Criticism](https://libguides.mit.edu/architect): Architecture and Art History research guide with citation tools and art history databases
- [Art and Architecture of the Islamic World](https://libguides.mit.edu/islam-arch): Islamic art and architecture research guide with Aga Khan resources and specialized collections
- [Biography](https://libguides.mit.edu/biography): Biography research guide with biographical dictionaries and comprehensive biographical databases

## Research Methods & Collections

- [Introduction to Archival Research](https://libguides.mit.edu/archival-research): Introduction to archival research with MIT Distinctive Collections and special collections resources

## Social Sciences & Policy

- [Affirmative Action](https://libguides.mit.edu/affirmative-action): Research guide on affirmative action and diversity in higher education with policy resources
- [American Indigenous Studies Resources](https://libguides.mit.edu/indigenous): American Indigenous Studies research guide with community resources and specialized collections
